comparison.objective: Zero an unpowered robot joint by holding its link on a mark and inserting a calibration pin; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual gravity-loaded link support, hole alignment and pin insertion versus counterholding, recessed hex-key use, collar adjustment and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Pin home with joint within 1° of zero, safely released and stationary; candidate requires two acceptable energized test cycles after adjustment. Candidate lacks numeric rebound/overload/drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot maintenance, but joint zeroing tests alignment under gravity and pin insertion rather than damping selection.
